Every other inventoried quotation is kept, and all 106 multi-word quotations in the body were rechecked word for word against the saved source texts. The stacked attributions that remain are ones a quotation needs, chiefly the 2015 USA Today/ComicBook.com paragraph and the secondhand father paragraph.
